channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: Shingles Vaccine Tied to Fewer Dementia Diagnoses
item.description: Herpes zoster vaccination was associated with reduced dementia diagnoses in elderly Canadian adults throughout natural experiments. The post Shingles Vaccine Tied to Fewer Dementia Diagnoses appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Deep-Learning CT Model Predicts Survival in NSCLC
item.description: A deep-learning serial CT biomarker accurately predicts overall survival in immunotherapy-treated NSCLC, outperforming RECIST in large real-world and trial cohorts. The post Deep-Learning CT Model Predicts Survival in NSCLC appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Informal Caregivers’ Feeding Experiences in Pediatric Cancer
item.description: A qualitative review shows informal caregivers adapt feeding for children with cancer, often straining home routines and wellbeing. The post Informal Caregivers’ Feeding Experiences in Pediatric Cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Oral Bacteria Linked to Liver Scarring Acceleration
item.description: New research shows that bacteria normally found in the mouth can travel to the gut and promote liver scarring by damaging the gut barrier. The post Oral Bacteria Linked to Liver Scarring Acceleration appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: The Rising Burden of Frailty in People with HIV
item.description: New modelling study estimates major lifetime health and cost burden from frailty and falls in people with HIV in the USA, highlighting need for prevention. The post The Rising Burden of Frailty in People with HIV appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Deep Learning Unlocks Prognostic Power of FDG PET-CT
item.description: Deep learning integration of FDG PET-CT and clinical data significantly improves survival prediction in non-metastatic breast cancer, offering a transparent and more precise approach to prognostic stratification. The post Deep Learning Unlocks Prognostic Power of FDG PET-CT appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Benefit of Acupuncture for Migraine Backed by Brain Imaging
item.description: A new trial shows acupuncture for migraine eases pain and disability, and brain connectivity imaging may predict who benefits most. The post Benefit of Acupuncture for Migraine Backed by Brain Imaging appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Telomere Genetics Reshape Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis Risk
item.description: Large genetic study links telomere-related polygenic risk to distinct idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis subgroups, improving disease prediction. The post Telomere Genetics Reshape Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Atrial Fibrillation Linked to Cognitive Decline
item.description: The study reported that 40.1% of patients with AF had either large non-cortical and cortical infarcts or small non-cortical infarcts, compared with 24.0% of patients without AF. The post Atrial Fibrillation Linked to Cognitive Decline appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Platelet Processing Influences Transfusion Needs in Children
item.description: A large paediatric cohort study shows that platelet processing and donor factors influence posttransfusion platelet increments and transfusion burden, without affecting hospital length of stay or mortality. The post Platelet Processing Influences Transfusion Needs in Children appeared first on European Medical Journal.
